package fixture

import (
	"context"

	"metaldocs/internal/platform/tenant"
)

type definedTenantID string

// Defined result types are not identical to the predeclared string result
// types expected by actorFromCtx.
func notAnActorFromCtxDefinedResult(ctx context.Context) (definedTenantID, definedTenantID, error) {
	id, err := tenant.FromContext(ctx)
	return definedTenantID(id), definedTenantID(id), err
}
